g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in, the offer copy states the reward (an hour of Search), declining leaves the menu unchanged, and the ad-fail path hides the card or reports the failure.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of Search access, which has no cash value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is returning to the profile menu from the Upgrade entry, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: An hour of Search is only a reward if Search is otherwise locked, and the 'when the reward runs out' field implies it is. That would lock the Search tab (s05), which free users have today.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in the profile menu sheet (s09), which is over a non-chat screen and rated safe, and it is not in a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: For an existing_anchor, the app must charge for or limit the resource. The model shows no charge or limit on Search (m02 and m03 cover swipes, context and routing), so the reward gives a resource the app neither charges for nor limits.

c2_evidence.reason: The proposal says Search lets users find characters 'by name and trait filters', and that it is 'something free users can use right away'. The model records no s05 elements and no Search mechanic, so neither claim is supported. The idea also depends on Search being gated, which is never observed.

c3_spares_payers.reason: Subscribers never see the card, and Search is not part of the Janitor+ benefits in m02.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of Search, which is not the subscription's main benefit, and it expires. It takes nothing from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The card sits on the profile menu, a persistent surface the user chooses to open (f03), right after they looked at the upgrade and left.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The unit is a play-to-earn sponsored game, and the flow grants the hour only after the verified play. The trigger is a detectable navigation event.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the profile menu, the Upgrade to Janitor Plus entry (s09.e31) and the Search tab, so it is tied to this app.

other_concern: The destination of the Upgrade entry was not observed, so 'returns from the Upgrade entry' may be hard to detect in practice. Two rewards a day is also generous for a feature that costs the app nothing.
